title: Izwi Dutu Risati Rasvika
intro: Mumwe munhu murenje akasimuka achidana rudzi rune simba kuti rudzokere kuchokwadi. Vanhu vacho vaizivikanwa nezvivakwa zvavo zvakanaka uye simba risingaenzaniswi. Asi kuzvikudza kwavo kwakavapofumadza, uye vakaramba kuteerera. Pakupedzisira, chirango chinoparadza chakavawira, chikasiya boka diki revatendi chete.
clues: Ndakatumwa kuvanhu vane simba vaigara munzvimbo dzisina miti uye vaizivikanwa nesimba ravo.
Vanhu vangu vakauya vachitevera rumwe rudzi rukuru rwakanga rwaparadzwa.
Vaiva nezvivakwa zvakanaka kwazvo uye vakavaka shongwe refu.
Ndakavadana kuti vanamate Mwari Mumwe chete, asi vakaramba kusiya zvifananidzo zvavo.
Chirango chakasimba chakavabata, vakasiya chete avo vakatenda pamwe chete neni.
Ndini ndakatumwa kuvanhu vane simba vanozivikanwa saAad.

Vanhu vangu vakarohwa nekudengenyeka kwenyika uye vanochema
Vanhu vangu vakatemwa nematombo kubva kudenga

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
